mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.views AS view_count, a.likes AS like_count, a.create_time AS created_time, ca.sort_order AS sort_order FROM portal_column_article ca INNER JOIN portal_article a ON a.id = ca.article_id WHERE ca.column_id = #{columnId} ORDER BY ca.sort_order ASC, ca.created_time ASC
